<thought>To propose a retrosynthetic route with a single Diels‑Alder step, I first need a retrosynthetic template that represents the reverse of a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. I will search the template catalog for reactions that form two C–C bonds and change the order of two C=C bonds, which is characteristic of a Diels‑Alder forward reaction. This should return a suitable template ID that I can use in the final JSON route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-6"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)", "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
